CHECK BURST CS-check-02 — assemble the cliffside 2×2 portion (chunks A, B, C, D) with MINIMUM-ERROR SEAM CUTS and measure the seams (Matt R-C3-46). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-check-02".

Inputs (read-only): painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-A/chunk_A.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-B/chunk_B.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-C/chunk_C.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-chunk-D/chunk_D.png (1536×1024 each; flat #00ff00 = void); masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/chunk_<A|B|C|D>_mask.png; placement on a 2816×1792 portion canvas: C at (0,0), D at (1280,0), A at (0,768), B at (1280,768) (256-px overlaps between every neighbouring pair); /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides/shadow_ellipse.png; background /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-vista-01/vista_01.png; Keeper frames /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/idle_S/frames/idle/S/idle_S_00.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells/walk_E/frames/walk/E/walk_E_03.png. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files.

STEP 1 — per chunk RGBA exactly as CS-check-01: clamp-matte alpha restricted to the blockout mask dilated 6 px.
STEP 2 — seams: composite in the order A, then B, then C, then D. When a new chunk is placed over pixels already on the portion canvas, inside each overlap band compute cost = mean |RGB| difference (0–255) between the existing canvas and the new chunk where both are foreground (where only one is foreground, cost 0 and that one wins; where neither, void); find the MINIMUM-COST connected path across the band by dynamic programming (vertical path for a left/right overlap, horizontal path for a top/bottom overlap; each step may move ±1 px); take the existing canvas on one side of the path and the new chunk on the other; feather ±3 px across the path. For D (which overlaps both C on its left and B below) cut the left band and the bottom band separately and give their corner square to the lower of the two costs. Report per seam (A|B, C|D, C/A, D/B): the mean cost along the chosen path, its 95th percentile, and — for comparison — the mean cost over the whole band (what a crossfade would mix). Write out/seam_paths.png (the portion with each chosen path drawn in 2-px magenta) and out/seam_closeups.png (a 512×512 crop centred on each seam, unmarked, 2×2 grid).
STEP 3 — portion composite: background vista scaled uniformly (LANCZOS) to cover 2816×1792 (centred crop; report scale) behind the foreground; Keepers as before: idle feet at portion (1280+306, 768+157) = (1586, 925), walk frame 90 px right, 130 px tall, shadow ellipse under each. Write out/portion_2x2_composite.png and out/portion_2x2_noKeeper.png.
STEP 4 — screen view: out/screen_view_1920x1080.png = the 1920×1080 frame whose pixel (962,595) is the idle Keeper's feet (portion origin (624,330) — entirely inside the painted portion; report if any pixel falls outside), and out/screen_view_960x540.png.
STEP 5 — out/review.html (self-contained, relative paths): screen view first, then the portion composite, seam closeups, seam paths, and a table of the four seams (path mean / p95 / whole-band mean) with CS-check-01's crossfade seam (31.3) noted for comparison. out/checks.json; out/summary.txt ≤ 12 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 13 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-check-02"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
